2608.30021.title: Error Detection for PET/CT Radiology Reports: Domain-Specific vs Large Language Models
2608.30021.paper_summary: Errors in radiology reports can adversely affect patient treatment, yet automated report quality assurance remains challenging because errors are often subtle and require domain expertise to detect. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently been proposed for radiology report verification, their ability to detect clinically meaningful errors beyond chest X-ray datasets remains under-explored. To this end, we present the first systematic evaluation of language models for PET/CT report error detection, comparing compact domain-specific models with SOTA open-weight LLMs. We collected 30,633 oncology FDG PET/CT reports from 23 radiologists over 10 years. We trained domain-specific BERT models to detect clinically motivated synthetic reporting errors and evaluated alongside zero-/few-shot Qwen3-32B, Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.3-70B on a held-out benchmark of 11,500 reports. A 15M-parameter model achieved 94.4% balanced accuracy with a 5.8% false-positive rate, compared with 84.0% for the strongest prompted LLM. Task-specific adaptation of Llama-3.3-70B closed this performance gap (94.4%) but retained substantially greater computational requirements. Our results suggest that domain-specific training matters more than model scale for PET/CT report error detection, supporting compact models as an accurate and computationally efficient approach to automated radiology report quality assurance.
2608.30021.paper_summary_zh: 放射學報告中的錯誤可能會對患者治療產生不利影響，但自動化報告質量保證仍然面臨挑戰，因為錯誤往往是微妙的，並且需要領域專業知識來檢測。雖然最近提出了大型語言模型（LLMs）用於放射學報告驗證，但它們在檢測超越胸部X光數據集的臨床意義錯誤的能力仍然未被充分探索。為此，我們提出了針對PET/CT報告錯誤檢測的首個系統性評估，將緊湊的領域特定模型與最先進的開放權重LLMs進行比較。我們從23位放射科醫生那裡收集了10年內的30,633份腫瘤學FDG PET/CT報告。我們訓練了領域特定的BERT模型來檢測臨床動機的合成報告錯誤，並在11,500份報告的保留基準上與零/少量樣本的Qwen3-32B、Gemma-3-27B和Llama-3.3-70B進行評估。一個15M參數的模型實現了94.4%的平衡準確率，假陽性率為5.8%，相比之下，最強的提示LLM為84.0%。針對特定任務的Llama-3.3-70B適應縮小了這一性能差距（94.4%），但仍然保持了更高的計算需求。我們的結果表明，對於PET/CT報告錯誤檢測，領域特定訓練比模型規模更為重要，支持緊湊模型作為自動化放射學報告質量保證的準確且計算效率高的方法。
